decisions.reason: The modular plant concept has documented customer savings well above aspiration, so no shortfall triggers search and the growing firm keeps it.
The slow-speed shredder is close to the core business, has its own page and may be succeeded by the newer E line, but nothing signals a shortfall that would justify dropping it within a year.
As the flagship modular line aligned with the strategic direction, it is protected by slack in a growing firm while its results mature.
The trommel screen extends a core category at low incremental risk, and there is no evidence of performance below aspiration.
The recently launched multi-model shredder line sits at the firm's core and has its own page, so it is far too early for any shortfall to prompt removal.
The new spiral shaft screen line builds on established know-how and is in its early phase, which slack in a growing firm readily carries.
